handoffs.information: Structured objective spec with verbatim spans and UNSTATED markers

handoffs.information: Single metric recognition rule (when cash counts)

handoffs.information: Owner profile with per-item status (held/unknown/absent) and source

handoffs.information: Owner advantages (held only)

handoffs.information: Screened candidates plus rejected/deferred ones with reasons

handoffs.information: Full strategy specs with assumptions and UNKNOWN legs

handoffs.information: Research brief: quantity, scope, acceptance criteria, decision link, stop rule

handoffs.information: Captured source with snapshot and retrieval state

handoffs.information: Conflict records and reconciled values
